digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: Acceptance criteria that no longer match reality block the completion verifier's close gate, with no legitimate sanctioned path forward short of force-close or referencing stale commits
Closing against invalidated criteria via --force-close or --ref to old commits leaves inaccurate ticket state in the shared record
The --ref mechanism is a legitimate close path for criteria invalidated by subsequent commits, but fails when criteria are invalidated by the fix itself or are auto-generated/unverifiable
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding genuinely completed work

Documentation and workflow guidance are needed to distinguish between legitimate close paths (--ref for post-work invalidation) and genuinely unaddressed subclasses (criteria invalidated by fix, auto-generated criteria, automation-owned tickets)
